title: PaperCritic: Training AI Reviewers to Assess the Soundness of Papers
abstract: arXiv:2611.17834v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As AI conference submissions grow rapidly, AI reviewers are being considered as an alternative. However, simply imitating human reviewing is problematic because reviewing serves multiple purposes, including evaluating papers' soundness, interestingness, and clarity, the last two of which are subjective. In this work, we focus solely on evaluating soundness, the most important and objective criterion, and define the learning objective as jointly maximizing (1) precision, based on the soundness and substantiveness of review points, and (2) recall, the coverage of high-quality reference review points. Under this problem formulation, we construct a quality-labeled review point dataset, PaperSound-23K, using 1K ICLR submissions and 23K human-written and LLM-generated review points. translated_title: PaperCritic：训练AI审稿人来评估论文的可靠性
translated_abstract: 随着AI会议投稿量的快速增长，AI审稿人正被视为一种替代方案。然而，简单地模仿人类审稿是有问题的，因为审稿服务于多种目的，包括评估论文的可靠性、趣味性和清晰度，其中后两者是主观的。在这项工作中，我们仅专注于评估可靠性——最重要且客观的标准，并将学习目标定义为同时最大化：（1）精确率，基于审稿观点的可靠性和实质性；（2）召回率，即对高质量参考审稿观点的覆盖率。基于这一问题设定，我们利用1K篇ICLR投稿和23K条人类撰写及LLM生成的审稿观点，构建了一个带有质量标签的审稿观点数据集PaperSound-23K。利用该数据集，我们通过强化学习训练了一个AI审稿人模型PaperCritic，以精确率和召回率的F1分数作为奖励。
tldr: 该论文提出PaperCritic模型，通过构建包含23K条质量标注审稿观点的PaperSound-23K数据集，并以精确率和召回率的F1分数作为奖励进行强化学习训练，实现了专注于客观评估论文可靠性的AI审稿人。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PaperCritic, an AI reviewer model trained via reinforcement learning with F1-score as the reward on the PaperSound-23K quality-labeled dataset, focusing solely on objectively assessing the soundness of papers rather than imitating the subjective aspects of human reviewing.
